properties.Caption: View from South of Ferry Building

From proposal: "The Golden Gateway Center proposes three 22-story apartment buildings placed at the perimeters of the site, each above its garage. The three garages come together to form a circular court which is developed at the shopping circle and the huh for all pedestrian travel. Two-thirds of the public garage have been placed below ground in order to provide a public square at street level on half of the site, and a mall plaza at the third-floor level on the remainder."
View from the bay, looking west down Washington Street.
